title: Ankhorage Capability
summary: Provides runtime validation, normalization, equality, and catalog operations for capabilities.
purpose: Offer reusable capability operations without coupling consumers to a specific host or provider.
responsibilities: Compare capability values and operate on capability catalogs.
boundaries: Does not provide provider-specific capability implementations.
Does not acquire capabilities from a host environment.
audience: Package and application authors that model capabilities.

invariants: Operations are independent of a concrete capability provider.

limitations: Consumers supply the capability values and catalogs to operate on.
